proposals.evidence: Full indradhanus gives rainbow and Pali indradhanu, Prakrit imdadhanu/imdahanu. The selected eastern Indra-dhanu forms preserve both lexical elements with regional cluster simplification, vowel variation, and source d/dh or retroflex transcription retained. Learned or cross-IA transmission remains qualified. Exact response: indṛo danasə.
